# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_FLIP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon flips from bullish to bearish alignment after the midday lull (between 11:30-13:00 EST), short momentum often follows. This edge exists because the midday lull often sees a pause in momentum, and a ribbon flip after this period indicates a shift in intraday trend that can be captured for a short move.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Time between 11:30‑13:00 EST AND EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50 (ribbon down) AND prior bar had EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon) AND price closes below VWAP AND volume > 1.2× average volume of the last 5 bars.

Exit shape: Stop at the high of the flip bar, target using chart‑stop at the prior swing high (or 1R), runner trail using a premium‑stop of 20% of ATR.

Regime hint: VIX > 20, 15‑min market structure showing a lower high (possible downtrend), and avoiding the first and last 30 min of the session.
